description: This is a service worker script implementing an offline-first cache strategy for a web application. It caches essential shell files on installation, manages cache updates during activation, intercepts fetch requests to serve cached content, and updates cache entries when new content is fetched.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Event handler that caches shell URLs during the service worker installation process and skips waiting to activate immediately.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Event handler that clears outdated caches and claims control of clients during activation.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Event handler that intercepts fetch requests, serving from cache or network as appropriate, and updates the cache dynamically.
